title: Episode 11: What belongs in the standard library?

sentences.zh: 我们开始吧。

sentences.en: Welcome to ADSP, the podcast, episode 11, recorded on January 24th, 2021.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听播客 ADSP 第 11 期，录制于 2021 年 1 月 24 日。

sentences.en: My name is Connor, and today with my co-host, Bryce, we talk about what belongs in a standard library and more.
sentences.zh: 我是康纳，今天我和我的联合主持人布莱斯将探讨什么才该属于标准库等话题。

sentences.en: I got an idea.
sentences.zh: 我有个想法。

sentences.en: You got an idea?
sentences.zh: 你有个想法？

sentences.en: I got an idea.
sentences.zh: 我有个想法。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think we should talk about what belongs in the standard library.
sentences.zh: 对，我觉得我们应该聊聊什么属于标准库。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Is this C++ specific or is this...
sentences.zh: 这是 C++ 专属的，还是说……

sentences.en: I kind of think it is.
sentences.zh: 我倒觉得是的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Because, well, I guess it's kind of a comparison of language standard libraries.
sentences.zh: 因为，呃，我想这算是对各种语言标准库的一种对比。

sentences.en: Is really a part of this.
sentences.zh: 确实是其中的一部分。

sentences.en: Because I think that the...
sentences.zh: 因为我觉得……

sentences.en: There are a lot of people trying to put things in the C++ standard library.
sentences.zh: 有很多人正试图把各种东西塞进 C++ 标准库里。

sentences.en: And I think a lot of the things that people wish to see in the C++ standard library that aren't suitable for the C++ standard library, folks want to see those things because they
sentences.zh: 而且我觉得，大家希望在 C++ 标准库中看到但又其实并不适合放进去的很多东西，人们之所以想看到它们，是因为

sentences.en: expect them to be there in other languages standard libraries.
sentences.zh: 他们期望在其他语言的标准库里能有这些东西。

sentences.en: And they perhaps don't understand the difference between the C++ standard library and the standard library of other languages.
sentences.zh: 并且他们可能并不理解 C++ 标准库与其他语言标准库的区别。

sentences.en: So just because two languages both say that they have a standard library or foundational libraries
sentences.zh: 所以，仅仅因为两门语言都说它们拥有标准库或基础库，

sentences.en: doesn't mean that they're the same thing or that they have the same requirements or that they have the same challenges.
sentences.zh: 并不意味着它们是同一个东西，或者它们有相同的要求、面临相同的挑战。

sentences.en: And I think first we have to start by defining what a standard library is for C++ or for any language.
sentences.zh: 而且我认为，首先我们必须为 C++ 或任何语言定义标准库的用途是什么。

sentences.en: And I think that standard libraries have one key property.
sentences.zh: 并且我认为标准库有一个关键属性。

sentences.en: And it's the one key property that everybody's interested in.
sentences.zh: 这也是每个人都关心的那个关键属性。

sentences.en: And that property is the standard libraries are the set of libraries that are available when you install the language without adding any extra packages.
sentences.zh: 那个属性就是，标准库是在你安装语言时无需添加任何额外软件包就能直接使用的库的集合。

sentences.en: So when you just install the base Python packages, which libraries do you get without adding other Python libraries?
sentences.zh: 所以，当你仅仅安装基础的 Python 软件包时，在不添加其他 Python 库的情况下，你能得到哪些库？

sentences.en: When you install a C++ compiler, what libraries do you have without adding other libraries?
sentences.zh: 当你安装一个 C++ 编译器时，在不添加其他库的情况下，你拥有哪些库？

sentences.en: When you install Java, what class libraries do you have without going and adding other ones?
sentences.zh: 当你安装 Java 时，在不去添加其他类库的情况下，你拥有哪些类库？

sentences.en: And the reason why this property is key is because things that are in that set of standard libraries
sentences.zh: 这个属性之所以关键，是因为那些处于这组标准库中的东西——

sentences.en: that are automatically installed with the language or compiler, they get implicit distribution.
sentences.zh: 也就是随语言或编译器自动安装的东西——能够获得隐式的分发。

sentences.en: You know, if I tell you, hey, here's this awesome package, and you're like, great, I want to use it,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，如果我告诉你，嘿，这里有个超棒的软件包，而你说，太棒了，我想用它，

sentences.en: you're more likely to use that package if you don't have to install it, if you just happen to have it installed on your system.
sentences.zh: 如果你不需要安装它，如果你的系统里恰好已经安装了它，你就会更有可能去使用这个软件包。

sentences.en: And that is the case for the standard library.
sentences.zh: 标准库就是这种情况。

sentences.en: Whereas if the package is something that you have to install, even if it's in a language where it's very easy
sentences.zh: 然而，如果某个软件包是你必须自己去安装的，哪怕是在一个安装第三方软件包非常容易的语言里，

sentences.en: to install a third-party package, something like Python or Rust, that is still an extra hurdle.
sentences.zh: 比如 Python 或 Rust，那依然是一道额外的门槛。

sentences.en: And, you know, you might be in a space where, you know, you're like, oh, I don't want to add extra dependencies.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，你可能会处于这样一种情境：你可能会想，哦，我不想添加额外的依赖。

sentences.en: There's still this extra step that you have to do, and it makes it less likely that people are going to use that library.
sentences.zh: 这依然是你必须执行的额外步骤，它会降低人们使用该库的可能性。

sentences.en: And so that's what I think really makes a standard library is that it is a component that comes with the language by default.
sentences.zh: 所以，这就是我认为真正构成标准库的特质：它是一个默认随语言附带的组件。

sentences.en: Does that make sense?
sentences.zh: 这说得通吗？

sentences.en: Yes, that made sense.
sentences.zh: 是的，这说得通。

sentences.en: And to summarize, so the key property of a standard library is just that it comes with the language.
sentences.zh: 总结一下，标准库的关键属性就是它随语言附带。

sentences.en: That's the key property.
sentences.zh: 这就是关键属性。

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 对，完全正确。

sentences.en: And so, you know, that explains why there is a desire to have rich standard libraries.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，这就解释了为什么人们会有拥有丰富标准库的渴望。

sentences.en: Because, you know, if you think that there's something that's really important for your programmers to have access to,
sentences.zh: 因为，如果你认为有些东西对你的程序员来说非常重要，必须能够使用，

sentences.en: or that's going to make it, you know, it's going to make your language better,
sentences.zh: 或者这能让你的语言变得更好，

sentences.en: and, like, why wouldn't you want it to just be there by default?
sentences.zh: 那么，为什么不希望它默认就存在呢？

sentences.en: Like, it's the easiest option if all you care about is getting your library into the hands of programmers.
sentences.zh: 如果你只关心如何让程序员用上你的库，这绝对是最简单的选择。

sentences.en: The easiest option by far is just to have everybody implicitly install it.
sentences.zh: 把所有东西都让大家隐式安装，这是迄今为止最简单的途径。

sentences.en: It's the easiest route to get adoption.
sentences.zh: 这是获得普及最简便的路线。

sentences.en: But, you know, there is a coSt.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，这也是有代价的。

sentences.en: So, you know, the first cost is, of course, that the larger that core set of libraries is, the larger your actual, you know, core package is.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，首先的代价当然是，核心库的集合越大，你实际的核心软件包也就越大。

sentences.en: You know, one of the key principles of C++ is you don't pay for what you don't use.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，C++ 的核心原则之一就是：你不用就不需要为之付出一分钱。

sentences.en: And so, everything that you add to that standard library makes the size of that, you know, core package larger and larger.
sentences.zh: 所以，你加到标准库里的每一样东西，都会让那个核心软件包的体积越来越大。

sentences.en: But I think more importantly, perhaps, there is a maintenance coSt.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得更重要的或许是维护成本。

sentences.en: I think most languages try to have a set of standard libraries that have a coherent design to them.
sentences.zh: 我觉得大多数语言都试图拥有一套设计连贯的标准库。

sentences.en: That it's not a collection of libraries, but it is one coherent library where all of the APIs sort of follow the same style.
sentences.zh: 它不是一堆零散库的集合，而是一个连贯的库，其中所有的 API 大体上都遵循相同的风格。

sentences.en: I will note what I think is an important exception to this, which is the Python standard libraries.
sentences.zh: 我要指出一个我认为很重要的例外，那就是 Python 标准库。

sentences.en: If you look at the set of, like, core Python libraries, there is actually a fairly notable divergence in the API style
sentences.zh: 如果你看看核心 Python 库的集合，你会发现那些库组件在 API 风格

sentences.en: and even the naming conventions among some of those library components.
sentences.zh: 甚至命名惯例上，其实存在着相当明显的差异。

sentences.en: And I believe that's because the way that it works in Python is that a number of those libraries started off as third-party libraries
sentences.zh: 我相信这是因为 Python 的运作方式是：其中许多库最初都是作为第三方库起步的，

sentences.en: and then they were adopted into sort of the core set.
sentences.zh: 然后才被采纳进入核心库集合中的。

sentences.en: Do you know if that's accurate?
sentences.zh: 你知道这准确吗？

sentences.en: I cannot confirm or deny that.
sentences.zh: 我既不能确认也不能否认这一点。

sentences.en: And I actually don't even know.
sentences.zh: 其实我甚至都不知道。

sentences.en: Like, off the top of my head, I know that there's, like, a built-in functions page.
sentences.zh: 就凭我的第一印象，我知道有一个诸如内置函数的页面。

sentences.en: But what are the Python – are they called core or standard?
sentences.zh: 但是 Python 的——它们被称为核心库还是标准库？

sentences.en: I don't know what they're called, but I'm thinking, like, the –
sentences.zh: 我不知道它们叫什么，但我想的是，比如——

sentences.en: The Python standard library is what it's called.
sentences.zh: 它被称为 Python 标准库。

sentences.en: Yeah, like, something – the thing, the one that comes to mind to me is, like, the Python libraries for parsing arguments.
sentences.zh: 对，比如——浮现在我脑海里的东西，比如 Python 用于解析参数的库。

sentences.en: Because I think I've – in my history of writing bad Python code, I think there are two different argument parsing libraries that have been around historically.
sentences.zh: 因为我想——在我编写烂 Python 代码的历史中，历史上似乎存在过两个不同的参数解析库。

sentences.en: I know one of them is, like, discouraged from being used these days, and that's probably the one that I'm used to using.
sentences.zh: 我知道其中一个现在已经不鼓励使用了，那可能就是我习惯用的那个。

sentences.en: And then I think the newer one's called argparse.
sentences.zh: 然后我觉得较新那个叫 argparse。

sentences.en: But, yeah, like, that's an example.
sentences.zh: 不过，对，这就是个例子。

sentences.en: Like, you've never had to install the package for argparse.
sentences.zh: 比如，你从来不需要为了 argparse 去安装什么软件包。

sentences.en: That just comes with your Python installation.
sentences.zh: 那东西随你的 Python 安装包一起就带有了。

sentences.en: But I believe that that was something that started off as its own library, and then it got added into that standard set.
sentences.zh: 但我相信那东西最初也是作为它自己的独立库开始的，然后才被加入到了那个标准集合中。

sentences.en: You know, somebody wrote some third-party library, and maybe they put it on GitHub,
sentences.zh: 你知道的，某人写了一些第三方库，也许他们把它放到了 GitHub 上，

sentences.en: and then it eventually – the Python community decided to adopt it as part of the standard library.
sentences.zh: 然后最终——Python 社区决定将其采纳为标准库的一部分。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: My guess is just on – like, I'm on the Python docs website, and there is a massive number of libraries that are supported here.
sentences.zh: 我盲猜一下——比如，我正看着 Python 文档网站，这里支持的库数量极其庞大。

sentences.en: So I think, you know, if we have Python listeners, they can tweet at us and correct us.
sentences.zh: 所以我想，如果我们有 Python 听众，他们可以在推特上发消息来纠正我们。

sentences.en: But I'm pretty sure some of these – it's exactly what you said.
sentences.zh: 但我很确信其中一些库——完全就像你刚才说的那样。

sentences.en: It was a standalone library written by potentially, you know, core developers, but potentially not.
sentences.zh: 它是一个由潜在的（可能是核心开发人员，也可能不是）人编写的独立库。

sentences.en: And then it just became so useful that over time they were folded into the standard.
sentences.zh: 然后它变得如此有用，以至于随着时间推移，它们被吸纳进了标准中。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Specifically, like, I'm looking at Itertools, which is probably, like, one of the most common libraries that I use.
sentences.zh: 具体来说，比如我正在看 Itertools，这可能是我用得最多的库之一。

sentences.en: There's another version, more Itertools, which is basically just, like, an extension of that library.
sentences.zh: 还有另一个版本，more-itertools，它基本上就是那个库的扩展。

sentences.en: But that one's not in the standard.
sentences.zh: 但那个并不在标准库里。

sentences.en: You have to go to PyPI or whatever package manager and pip install it.
sentences.zh: 你必须去 PyPI 或别的什么包管理器那里 pip install 它。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And so one of the nice things about the Python standard library is it's very rich.
sentences.zh: 所以 Python 标准库的优点之一就是它非常丰富。

sentences.en: You know, there's a lot of different capabilities in there that you just get by default.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，里面有很多不同的功能，你默认就能直接获得。

sentences.en: But I think one of the places where it – one of the weaknesses is that it does not have that same interface consistency as other languages' standard libraries.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得它的弱点之一在于——它没有其他语言标准库那种一致的接口规范。

sentences.en: Because in Python, really, that – it's a collection of libraries.
sentences.zh: 因为在 Python 中，说实话，那——它是一堆库的集合。

sentences.en: It's not one coherent library.
sentences.zh: 它不是一个连贯的库。

sentences.en: It's a collection of different libraries.
sentences.zh: 它是一组不同库的组合。

sentences.en: And some of those different libraries may have slightly different ways of doing things or slightly different styles to them.
sentences.zh: 其中一些不同的库可能会采用略有不同的做事方式，或者带有略微不同的风格。

sentences.en: And, you know, if you look at, you know, a language like C++, which is very different from Python in a number of ways,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，如果你看看像 C++ 这样的语言，它在很多方面都与 Python 截然不同，

sentences.en: but arguably is most different in the design of the library and in terms of, like, the package management story,
sentences.zh: 但可以说它最大的不同在于库的设计以及包管理的历程，

sentences.en: even in C++, pretty much everything that's in the standard library started off as a third-party library.
sentences.zh: 即便在 C++ 中，标准库里的几乎所有东西也都是从第三方库开始起步的。

sentences.en: The original basis for the C++ standard library that was adopted in 98 was Alex Stepanov's STL library, which was this third-party library.
sentences.zh: 在 98 年被采纳的 C++ 标准库的最初基础，是亚历克斯·斯特帕诺夫（Alex Stepanov）的 STL 库，那正是一个第三方库。

sentences.en: Now, the standards committee, they knew they needed a standard library before Alex Stepanov came around.
sentences.zh: 当然，在亚历克斯·斯特帕诺夫出现之前，标准委员会就知道他们需要一个标准库。

sentences.en: And there were components of the standard library that weren't taken from the STL.
sentences.zh: 而且标准库中确实有一些组件并非取自 STL。

sentences.en: Like, I believe that, like, locales and I.O.
sentences.zh: 比如，我相信像 locale（地区设置）和 I/O 流

sentences.en: streams were not part of the STL.
sentences.zh: 就不属于 STL。

sentences.en: That was a separate component that did not necessarily come from any pre-existing third-party library.
sentences.zh: 那是独立组件，不一定来自任何预先存在的第三方库。

sentences.en: But things like the containers and the algorithms, et cetera, those all came from the STL.
sentences.zh: 但诸如容器和算法等等，这些全都是来自 STL。

sentences.en: So the committee, back when they were putting together 98, they said they recognized we need a library.
sentences.zh: 所以当年委员会在组装 98 标准时，他们认识到我们需要一个库。

sentences.en: And they started designing some of the components to it.
sentences.zh: 于是他们开始设计其中的一些组件。

sentences.en: But then at some point, I don't remember who, but somebody became aware of Alex's STL library.
sentences.zh: 但随后在某个时候，我不记得是谁了，有人注意到了亚历克斯的 STL 库。

sentences.en: And he was like, you know what?
sentences.zh: 然后他心想，你知道吗？

sentences.en: This is what the standard library should be.
sentences.zh: 这才是标准库该有的样子。

sentences.en: And he brought it to the committee.
sentences.zh: 于是他把它带给了委员会。

sentences.en: And he said, hey, look, here's this.
sentences.zh: 他说，嘿，看，这就是这个。

sentences.en: It's novel.
sentences.zh: 它是新颖的。

sentences.en: It's groundbreaking.
sentences.zh: 它是具有突破性的。

sentences.en: And I think that we should ship it.
sentences.zh: 我觉得我们应该把它发布出去。

sentences.en: And the committee really took a big risk on shipping the STL.
sentences.zh: 委员会为发布 STL 确实冒了极大的风险。

sentences.en: And if you ever want to learn a little bit more about the history of this,
sentences.zh: 如果你想更深入地了解这段历史，

sentences.en: John Kalb has given some really great talks about the history of C++ in general.
sentences.zh: 约翰·卡尔布（John Kalb）做过一些非常精彩的演讲，讲述 C++ 的整体历史。

sentences.en: But in particular, talking about this moment in C++'s history, I'm sure we'll add some links to them in the show notes.
sentences.zh: 但特别是在谈到 C++ 历史上的这一刻时，我们肯定会在节目文稿中添加一些指向它们的链接。

sentences.en: But this is really a monumentous decision for C++ to take this risk on this sort of unproven design.
sentences.zh: 对于 C++ 来说，冒着风险采纳这种未经时间检验的设计，确实是一个具有重大意义的决定。

sentences.en: And then if you look at the next big revision of the C++ standard library, C++11, back during that time, you know, people joked that that was essentially just standardizing BooSt.
sentences.zh: 然后，如果你看看 C++ 标准库的下一次重大修订——C++11，在那段时期，你知道的，人们开玩笑说那基本上就是把 Boost 标准化了。

sentences.en: Boost was this, you know, this popular collection of third-party C++ libraries.
sentences.zh: Boost 当时就是这样一个广受欢迎的 C++ 第三方库集合。

sentences.en: And C++11 adopted many of those libraries, like the Boost Atomics library, the Boost Thread library.
sentences.zh: C++11 采纳了许多这样的库，比如 Boost Atomics 库、Boost Thread 库。

sentences.en: There's probably a number of other ones that I'm not thinking of, but being primarily somebody who does concurrent programming, those are the two that come to mind.
sentences.zh: 可能还有一些我一时想不起来的其他库，但由于我主要从事并发编程，这两个是我脑海中最先浮现的。

sentences.en: And then in C++17, our next big library release, we standardized parallel algorithms based on a library I work on, Thrust, and a file system library based on Boost file system.
sentences.zh: 接着在 C++17 中，作为我们的下一个重大库版本，我们标准化了基于我参与开发的 Thrust 库的并行算法，以及基于 Boost Filesystem 的文件系统库。

sentences.en: And ranges that came in C++20, you know, started off as a very popular library on GitHub.
sentences.zh: 而 C++20 中引入的 ranges，你知道的，最初也是 GitHub 上一个非常热门的库。

sentences.en: So C++ has followed the same model of sort of adopting designs from existing third-party libraries.
sentences.zh: 所以 C++ 一直遵循着这种从现有的第三方库中采纳设计的模式。

sentences.en: One of the things that the mantra I like to tell people about what belongs in the standard library is we standardize existing practice when there is a clear need.
sentences.zh: 我常向人们传授的关于什么该属于标准库的座右铭之一是：当存在明确需求时，我们对现有实践进行标准化。

sentences.en: And by standardized existing practice, what I mean is we don't try to invent things, you know, ourselves and the committee when possible.
sentences.zh: 所谓对现有实践进行标准化，我的意思是委员会尽可能不去自己凭空发明东西。

sentences.en: Whenever we have the opportunity to look at what's in the wild and to adopt that, we try to do that.
sentences.zh: 每当有机会观察外界有哪些成果并将其采纳时，我们都会尽量这么做。

sentences.en: And one of the ways that we know that something is maybe ripe for standardization is if we see three or four different versions of basically the same thing in different frameworks.
sentences.zh: 而我们判断某样东西是否已经成熟到可以标准化的方法之一，就是如果我们看到不同的框架中出现了三四个基本相同的不同版本。

sentences.en: Then maybe that means that it's time to standardize it.
sentences.zh: 那么这或许就意味着是时候将其标准化了。

sentences.en: So one of the best ways to get your thing standardized in C++ to get your thing added to the standard library is if you can make a list in your paper where you can say,
sentences.zh: 因此，想让你的东西在 C++ 中被标准化、让你的东西被加入标准库的最好方法之一，就是在你的提案中列出一份清单，让你能够说：

sentences.en: here's links to five open source libraries that have a construct called, you know, whatever that's the same thing as this construct in this paper.
sentences.zh: 这里有一些开源库的链接，它们的结构，你知道的，和这篇论文里的这种结构是完全一样的。

sentences.en: And if I can go and look at each one of those things and I can look through and say, hey, yeah, all of these things are the same thing.
sentences.zh: 如果我去逐个查看这些东西，然后顺着看下去说：“嘿，对啊，所有这些东西其实都是同一个东西。”

sentences.en: Then that indicates that, yeah, this is a design that is used in the wild by a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 那么这就说明，对，这确实是一种在实际应用中被许多人广泛使用的设计。

sentences.en: And it's even better if you can do this in a way that demonstrates that there's a need for interoperability.
sentences.zh: 如果你能以某种方式证明存在对互操作性的需求，那就更好了。

sentences.en: Like if of all five of those libraries expose this type,
sentences.zh: 比如，如果所有这五个库都公开了这种类型，

sentences.en: but they're not all interoperable and a user might want to pass one of these kinds of things into each one of those libraries,
sentences.zh: 但它们并非全部具有互操作性，而用户可能希望将其中某一种类型传递给每一个这样的库，

sentences.en: well, then that makes a case for, hey, yeah, maybe this should be a part of the standard library, part of the vocabulary.
sentences.zh: 那么这就构成了一个理由：“嘿，对，也许这应该成为标准库的一部分，成为词汇类型的一部分。”

sentences.en: And yeah, so that is often sort of key to how we standardize in C++, this idea of we want to look at existing practice and we want to adopt existing practice,
sentences.zh: 所以，这通常可以说是我们在 C++ 中进行标准化的关键所在——这种理念就是我们想要参考现有的实践，我们想要采纳现有的实践，

sentences.en: not necessarily invent on our own.
sentences.zh: 而不一定是完全靠我们自己去凭空发明。

sentences.en: But this gets us to the big difference between the C++ standard library and a lot of other languages, which is the C++ standard library is a specification.
sentences.zh: 但这就引出了 C++ 标准库与许多其他语言之间最大的不同，那就是 C++ 标准库是一个规范。

sentences.en: It's not an implementation.
sentences.zh: 它不是一个实现。

sentences.en: And so even if we're adopting something that is, you know, based upon some existing third party library, we're not just taking that library and shipping it with C++ compilers.
sentences.zh: 因此，即使我们采纳的东西（你知道的）是基于某些现有的第三方库，我们也不是直接把那个库拿来跟 C++ 编译器一起发布。

sentences.en: There are three major standard library implementations.
sentences.zh: 目前有三个主要的标准库实现。

sentences.en: And when we standardize something, all three of those implementations have to go and implement it.
sentences.zh: 当我们把某个东西标准化时，这三个实现都必须去实现它。

sentences.en: And we have in recent years started to have some shared implementation between different libraries.
sentences.zh: 近年来，我们开始在不同的库之间实现一些共享的实现。

sentences.en: And this has been accelerated by the fact that the Microsoft standard library, which was the one of the three big ones that was not open source, was the Microsoft one.
sentences.zh: 这一进程得到了加速，因为微软的标准库——也就是三大主流中唯一一个不是开源的那个，即微软的标准库，

sentences.en: It is now open source.
sentences.zh: 现在已经是开源的了。

sentences.en: So now all of the libraries are open source.
sentences.zh: 所以现在所有的库都是开源的。

sentences.en: The GCC ones under a GPL license.
sentences.zh: GCC 的那些遵循 GPL 许可证。

sentences.en: The other two are under a very similar sort of license, are under a more liberal type of license.
sentences.zh: 另外两个则使用非常相似的许可证，采用的是更为宽松的许可证类型。

sentences.en: The LLVM ones under the LLVM license, of course.
sentences.zh: LLVM 的那些自然是遵循 LLVM 许可证。

sentences.en: And so this makes it easier to share code between them.
sentences.zh: 因此，这使得它们之间共享代码变得更容易了。

sentences.en: And so it looks like there's going to be some shared implementation of, for example, the parallel algorithms between some of these standard libraries.
sentences.zh: 所以看起来，例如在其中一些标准库之间，将会出现一些并行算法等方面的共享实现。

sentences.en: And my team, which has done some implementation work on some concurrency primitives, has made contributions to multiple standard libraries.
sentences.zh: 而我的团队在一些并发原语上做了一些实现工作，也对多个标准库做出过贡献。

sentences.en: So we're starting to see there be some shared implementation between them, but there's still different code bases.
sentences.zh: 所以我们开始看到它们之间存在一些共享的实现，但它们仍然是不同的代码库。

sentences.en: And so just off the bat, if you want to add something to the standard library in C++,
sentences.zh: 因此，开门见山地说，如果你想在 C++ 中向标准库添加某些东西，

sentences.en: it is 3x the implementation work and 3x the maintenance work of shipping it as a third-party library.
sentences.zh: 其实现工作量是将它作为第三方库发布的 3 倍，维护工作量也是 3 倍。

sentences.en: Because you need to land it in each one of these major standard library code bases.
sentences.zh: 因为你需要将它落地到每一个主流的标准库代码库中。

sentences.en: And another one of the challenges is, you know, the standard library, it really, it's deployed at a scale which is uncommon for other software.
sentences.zh: 另一个挑战是，你知道的，标准库它的部署规模在其他软件中真的非常罕见。

sentences.en: It runs on essentially every device on the planet.
sentences.zh: 它基本上运行在地球上的每一台设备上。

sentences.en: There's about 5 million C++ developer users, which is a very large developer user base.
sentences.zh: 大约有 500 万 C++ 开发者用户，这是一个非常庞大的开发者用户基础。

sentences.en: And it has to run on pretty much, you know, all types of hardware.
sentences.zh: 而且它几乎必须运行在，你知道的，所有类型的硬件上。

sentences.en: And for all various different types of applications.
sentences.zh: 并且要适配所有各种不同类型的应用。

sentences.en: So it has to worry about corner cases that other libraries may not need to.
sentences.zh: 所以它必须考虑其他库可能不需要操心的极端边界情况。

sentences.en: Because, like, if I'm providing a third-party library to do something, I can choose to say, I'm going to focus on these sets of users.
sentences.zh: 因为，比如如果我提供一个第三方库来做某事，我可以选择说：“我将专注于这一特定用户群体。”

sentences.en: And I recognize the validity of this other use case that you might have, but it's not a priority for me right now.
sentences.zh: 我承认你可能拥有的这种其他用例的合理性，但这目前不是我的首要任务。

sentences.en: Like, for example, rangesv3 selected a very specific set of compilers that it was going to focus on in a very specific set of platforMs.
sentences.zh: 比如，rangesv3 选择了一组非常特定的编译器以及一组非常特定的平台来进行重点支持。

sentences.en: Whereas C++ ranges in the standard library, they don't have that luxury because they have to be deployed everywhere that C++ compilers are deployed.
sentences.zh: 然而 C++ 标准库中的 ranges，它们就没有这种奢侈的选择，因为它们必须部署在所有部署了 C++ 编译器的敌方。

sentences.en: And we don't have the choice of just saying this library or this feature is not going to be available for all C++ users.
sentences.zh: 我们没得选，不能直接说这个库或这个功能将不面向所有 C++ 用户提供。

sentences.en: So it's about a blessing and a curse to have this implicit availability everywhere.
sentences.zh: 所以，拥有这种无处不在的隐式可用性，既是一种福气，也是一种诅咒。

sentences.en: That, yes, it means that everybody who installs the language just has the library, but it also means that the library has to work for everybody
sentences.zh: 是的，这意味着安装该语言的每个人都直接拥有这个库，但这也意味着该库必须为安装该语言的每一个人服务。

sentences.en: that's going to install the language.
sentences.zh: 要达到这个标准，门槛真的非常高。

sentences.en: That's a really high bar to clear.
sentences.zh: 而另一个真正的问题是，标准库的维护者往往并不是领域专家。

sentences.en: And the other real problem is that the people who are standard library maintainers aren't domain experts.
sentences.zh: 他们不一定是实现某种特定类型库的合适人选。

sentences.en: They're not necessarily the right person to implement, you know, some particular type of library.
sentences.zh: 他们可能不具备实现，你知道的，XML 解析器所需的正确专业知识。

sentences.en: They're not the right, maybe they don't have the right expertise to implement, you know, an XML parser.
sentences.zh: 而那些领域专家、实现 XML 解析器的专家，又缺乏标准库开发的经验。

sentences.en: And the people who are domain experts, who are experts in implementing XML parsers, they don't have the experience with standard library development.
sentences.zh: 他们不知道在那种规模下发布 C++ 标准库是怎样一种体验。

sentences.en: They don't know what it's like to have to ship in a C++ standard library at that scale.
sentences.zh: 所以要完成实际工作非常困难，而且话说回来，这些工作还必须在三个不同的地方分别进行。

sentences.en: So it's difficult to do the actual work, which again has to be done in three different places.
sentences.zh: 因此我想说，把东西放进标准库其实是非常低效的。

sentences.en: And so I'd argue that putting things in the standard library is actually very inefficient.
sentences.zh: 你最终不得不支持大量实际上并不需要你的东西的用户，以及大量你的库实际上并不需要被支持的环境和平台，

sentences.en: You end up having to support a lot of users who may not actually need your thing and a lot of environments and platforms
sentences.zh: 因为你在那里可能根本没有用户，但只要你进了标准库，你就依然得支持他们。

sentences.en: where your library may not actually really need to be supported because you might not have users there, but you still have to support them if you're in the standard library.
sentences.zh: 而且它的实现效率也很低，因为你必须按照标准库所期望的方式，在所有这些不同的标准库实现中分别去实现它。

sentences.en: And it's very inefficient to implement because you've got to implement it in all of these different standard library implementations in the way that standard library expects.
sentences.zh: 当然，这还没算上那个完全的问题，就是，你知道的，它究竟是怎么进入标准的？

sentences.en: And of course, that's just leaving out the whole question of, you know, how does it actually get into the standard?
sentences.zh: 你必须为这个东西编写真正的规范性规范（normative specification），而且你每三年才能更新一次这个规范性规范。

sentences.en: You have to write an actual normative specification for this thing and you can only update that normative specification every three years.
sentences.zh: 这完全抛开了一个发展速度（velocity）的问题。

sentences.en: And this is leaving inside entirely the question of velocity.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，C++ 标准库在稳定性方面非常优秀，但在修正错误方面却不怎么擅长。

sentences.en: You know, the C++ standard library is very good at stability, but it's not so good at fixing its mistakes.
sentences.zh: 我们要做出破坏 ABI 的更改和破坏 API 的更改是非常困难的。

sentences.en: It's very hard for us to make ABI breaking changes and API breaking changes.
sentences.zh: 它就在标准库里。

sentences.en: It is in the standard library.
sentences.zh: 这并不适合所有的第三方库。

sentences.en: And that's not the right fit for all third-party libraries.
sentences.zh: 某些第三方库可能希望以更快的速度演进，也许是因为它们所在的领域是一个充满活跃研究的领域，

sentences.en: Some third-party libraries might want to evolve faster, maybe because they're, you know, the domain that they're in is a domain where there's active research
sentences.zh: 每隔几年就会涌现出新算法，或者出现需要修改接口的创新。

sentences.en: and where every few years, you know, a new algorithm comes out where there's some innovation that requires interface changes.
sentences.zh: 所以，这就是我对标准库本质的一番唠叨。

sentences.en: So that's sort of, that's my rant on the nature of standard libraries.
sentences.zh: 所以，API 稳定性、

sentences.en: So, API stability,
sentences.zh: ABI 稳定性、三倍的实现工作量、三倍的维护工作量、平台支持。

sentences.en: ABI stability, three times the implementation work, three times the maintenance work, platform support.
sentences.zh: 基于所有这些原因，你是在试图论证不应该把任何东西放进去，或者不是什么都不放，而是只有极少数特定的东西才应该进入 C++ 标准库吗？

sentences.en: Are you trying to build an argument that nothing should go, or not nothing, but a very select number of things should be going in the C++ standard library for all of these reasons?
sentences.zh: 比如，我猜你一开始提到的一个关键属性是，你知道的，它是随语言附带的，人们可以轻易访问它，因而会被更多地使用。

sentences.en: Like, you started, I guess, with sort of the one key property is that, you know, it's what comes with the language and people have easy access to it and it'll get utilized more.
sentences.zh: 但随之而来的显然是一个巨大的代价，以及所有这些问题。

sentences.en: But then there's obviously, like, a huge price tag and all these things.
sentences.zh: 所以，我想，是不是……对于应该收录多少东西，你有什么看法？

sentences.en: So, I guess, is there, like, what are your thoughts on how much stuff?
sentences.zh: 我们是否应该试图减缓将东西放进标准库的速率？

sentences.en: Should we be trying to decelerate, like, the rate that we put things in?
sentences.zh: 因为，你看，当你回顾 98、11、17 和 20 时，你只提到了你喜欢的一小部分东西，你知道的，variant、optional，

sentences.en: Like, because, like, while you were going through 98 and 11 and 17 and 20, you only mentioned, like, a fraction of the things that you like, you know, variant, optional,
sentences.zh: 诸如此类被添加到标准库中的东西不胜枚举。

sentences.en: the list goes on and on and on of, like, what's being added to the standard library.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我不想挑出任何目前正处于提案流程中的具体论文，但确实有许多，你知道的，

sentences.en: And, you know, I don't want to pick out any of the papers that are currently in the proposal process, but there are a number of, you know,
sentences.zh: 相当庞大且并非微不足道的库正在被提议加入。

sentences.en: non-trivial libraries that are quite large that are being proposed.
sentences.zh: 并且，你知道的，

sentences.en: And, you know,
sentences.zh: 我确信并非所有这些提案都能通过，但我相信其中一些会的。

sentences.en: I'm sure not all of them will get in, but I'm sure some of them will.
sentences.zh: 对，对于（你知道的）我们是否应该尝试寻找一小部分东西来提交提案，你有什么看法？

sentences.en: Yeah, what are your thoughts on, you know, should we be trying to find a small set of things and propose those?
sentences.zh: 或者我们是否应该把所有的精力都投入到类似包管理器（package manager）的事情上去？

sentences.en: Or should we be trying to put all our energy into, like, a package manager?
sentences.zh: 所以，我的意思是，我绝对是精简版 C++ 标准库的倡导者。

sentences.en: So, I mean, I definitely am an advocate for a small C++ standard library.
sentences.zh: 而且我也坚信，很多关于庞大 C++ 标准库的需求，

sentences.en: And I do believe that a lot of the,
sentences.zh: 其实都源于 C++ 包管理机制的不足。

sentences.en: a lot of the desire for a big C++ standard library
sentences.zh: 我几年一直在说，我认为在未来 10 年里，我们能为 C++ 做的最重要的一件事，就是让在 C++ 项目中使用第三方库变得简单几个数量级。

sentences.en: comes from the insufficiency of C++ package management.
sentences.zh: 这意味着包管理，这意味着构建系统。

sentences.en: I've said for a few years that I think the single most important thing that we can do for C++ over the next 10 years is make it orders of magnitude easier
sentences.zh: 但这并不一定意味着必须在标准规范的范围内来做这两件事。

sentences.en: to use third-party libraries in C++ projects.
sentences.zh: 标准委员会实际上只拥有 C++ 程序文本的所有权。

sentences.en: And that means package management, that means build systeMs.
sentences.zh: 处理包管理或构建系统之类的事情稍微有点超出我们的职责范围，而且对我们来说做起来也会很棘手。

sentences.en: And that doesn't necessarily mean doing either of those things within the context of the standard.
sentences.zh: 但我认为，如果 C++ 拥有像 Rust 或 Python 那样丰富的包管理系统，

sentences.en: The standard committee really only owns the text of C++ prograMs.
sentences.zh: 大家就不会有那么大的需求非要把东西塞进标准库里了。

sentences.en: And dealing with things like package management or build systems is a little bit outside of our mandate and would also be tricky for us to do.
sentences.zh: 不过，标准库并不能替代包管理。

sentences.en: But I think that if, if, if, if C++ had a, as rich a package management system as say Rust or Python,
sentences.zh: 我认为关键在于，仅仅为了让人们能广泛使用某样东西，就将其放入 C++ 标准库是完全不充分的理由。

sentences.en: I don't think there would be as much demand to put things into the standard library.
sentences.zh: 由于高昂的实现成本，因为把东西放进标准库的效率非常低下，因为一旦我们把东西放进了标准库，

sentences.en: The standard library though, is not a substitute for package management.
sentences.zh: 以后要想修复它们就极其困难。

sentences.en: I think that's the key thing is that it is not a sufficient justification to put things in the C++ standard library simply so that they're widely available to people.
sentences.zh: 所有这些因素，我认为都在推动我们想要一个更小的标准库，因为那样做风险更低。

sentences.en: Because of the high costs to implement, because it's very inefficient to put things in the standard library, because once we put things into the standard library,
sentences.zh: 把东西放进标准库风险更高。

sentences.en: it's very hard to fix them later.
sentences.zh: 我们必须百分之百确定我们已经把它做对了。

sentences.en: All of those things, I think, push us towards wanting a smaller standard library because that's, that's lower risk.
sentences.zh: 至于我认为什么东西

sentences.en: Putting things into the standard library is higher risk.
sentences.zh: 属于标准库，

sentences.en: We have to be very certain that we've got them right.
sentences.zh: 我认为进入标准库的东西必须满足以下三个标准之一。

sentences.en: As for what I think
sentences.zh: 这就是我在“当存在明确需求时，我们对现有实践进行标准化”这一信条中所指的“明确需求”。

sentences.en: belongs in the standard library,
sentences.zh: 对，我正想问这个，因为，是的，所谓“明确需求”，取决于你和谁谈论，如果是科学家、硬件工程师还是其他人，

sentences.en: I think things that go into the standard library need to meet one of these three criterion.
sentences.zh: 他们的明确需求将是完全不同的。
